headline: Babahoyo Declares 90-Day Emergency as El Niño Flooding Disrupts Infrastructure
summary: The municipal emergency committee in Babahoyo, Ecuador declared a 90-day state of emergency after heavy El Niño rains flooded local parishes, destroyed transport roads, and forced schools to transition online.
why: Babahoyo is an agricultural hub in western Ecuador vulnerable to seasonal Pacific El Niño weather phenomena.

impacts.name: Ecuador
impacts.why: Severe El Niño flooding forced a 90-day municipal emergency declaration in Babahoyo.
